title: An agent fixed a bug and says: all tests pass
caption: Coding agents stop when their tests pass. But when the same agent writes the fix and the test, green is a claim, not evidence. Counterproof checks the claim.
output: Bug: percent_discount ignores the cap. A 25% discount on a 200.00 order with a 30.00 cap returns 50.00; it should return 30.00. A discount must never exceed its cap.
